provenance.basis: Candidate-authorized structural lessons from a matched application example

careerFacts.text: Maintained a Java equipment registry consumed by scheduling and maintenance applications. Extended the existing registry; did not create it.
Created an internal schema compiler that generated Kotlin and Java service bindings. Wrote setup examples that another team used without direct assistance.
Compared two persistence approaches and presented a migration proposal. The migration was not carried out.
Implemented Solidity reservation contracts for shared computing capacity. The team released one deployment; the candidate owned upgrade checks and contract test tooling.
Added property-based tests for reservation ownership and fuzz tests for release rules. The team adopted the checks in its build.
Fixed API authorisation defects reported by an external security firm. Another engineer coordinated the review. The report did not cover smart contracts.
Built a voucher escrow experiment with refund deadlines and approval policies. Cross-network messages were tested using a local simulator; no live cross-network transfer is established.
Built a local change-review tool with model-generated suggestions, a separate critique step, and human acceptance. It is an experimental personal project.
Completed an MSc in Computer Science. Additional training covered software architecture and secure application development.
